aeo_summary: Ashoka Greens is a ready-to-move plotted enclave by Bajania Associates in the Malyana belt, offering freehold residential plots with essential community features like a gym and on-site fire safety. It suits end-users seeking a low-density neighbourhood and investors looking for land-led appreciation in western Uttar Pradesh.
